patch_description: The current program regressed badly (score 1.00 vs prior 21.89) because it lost the local-search refinement. Restore the prior architecture: greedy seed plus move/swap local search, then add the recommended third phase — a bounded 3-way cyclic rotation among GPUs to escape optima that moves and swaps cannot. All moves are feasibility-checked and delta-evaluated with cached load/memory sums, restarting the outer loop on any accepted improvement.
